note: Every implementation MUST reproduce expected_payload_jcs, expected_content_hash, expected_core_jcs and expected_chain_hash byte for byte. For vectors with expected_valid=false the expected_* values are the correct ones and the record carries the defect. expected_notices lists the notice classes a verifier must report for the record on its own.

test_key.note: TEST KEY ONLY. This is RFC 8032 section 7.1 test vector 1 and is public knowledge. Never sign real evidence with it.

vectors.name: genesis-minimal
vectors.description: First record of a stream: prev_hash is the genesis value, no optional members. Payload keys are given out of order and must be sorted by JCS.

vectors.name: second-chained
vectors.description: Second record: prev_hash equals the chain_hash of genesis-minimal; seq is 1; optional time, actor and policy members are present and therefore part of the core.

vectors.name: chain-restart
vectors.description: Restart record: seq returns to 0, chain_restart is true, anchor_hash carries the last chain_hash of the previous segment and prev_hash equals anchor_hash. Both members are part of the core.

vectors.name: context-absent
vectors.description: Observation record without context. Compare with context-present: both must have the same chain_hash.

vectors.name: context-present
vectors.description: Same record as context-absent plus context, correlation_id, job_id and decision_id. None of these members is part of the core, so content_hash and chain_hash are unchanged.

context.note: context is informational and never hashed

vectors.name: redaction
vectors.description: The password was masked before content_hash was computed and the masked pointer is listed in redaction.fields. The redaction member itself is not part of the core.

vectors.name: jcs-edge-cases
vectors.description: Payload exercises RFC 8785: ES6 number formatting (1.0 -> 1, 1e21 -> 1e+21, -0.0 -> 0, 9007199254740993 -> 9007199254740992), minimal string escaping with lowercase \u00xx, literal non-ASCII, and member sorting by UTF-16 code units (U+1F680 before U+FF01). The integer beyond 2^53 must produce a number_precision notice.

payload.🚀: rocket U+1F680 sorts before U+FF01 in UTF-16
payload.Z: upper Z sorts before lower a

vectors.name: signed
vectors.description: Record signed with the TEST KEY: Ed25519 over the ASCII bytes of the chain_hash string, sig as base64url without padding. The signature member is not part of the core.

vectors.name: invalid-chain-hash
vectors.description: second-chained with the last hex digit of chain_hash changed. A verifier must report hash_mismatch; expected_chain_hash is the correct value.

vectors.name: invalid-content-hash
vectors.description: redaction with the payload altered after sealing. content_hash no longer matches, and because the core carries the recomputed content_hash, chain_hash differs as well. A verifier must report hash_mismatch.

vectors.name: seq-beyond-2-53
vectors.description: seq is a JSON string in canonical decimal form. 9007199254740993 (2^53 + 1) is hashed exactly as written; as a JSON number JCS would round it to 9007199254740992. Verifiers compare seq values as integers of arbitrary size, never as doubles.

vectors.name: seq-uint64-max
vectors.description: seq at its largest allowed value, 18446744073709551615 (2^64 - 1).

vectors.name: seq-legacy-integer
vectors.description: seq written as a JSON number, the form of format 0.1. Accepted during 0.x with the notice legacy_integer_seq; schema_invalid from 1.0. The hashes cover the member as written, so the core carries "seq":7, and 0.1 journals keep verifying.

vectors.name: seq-missing
vectors.description: No seq member. The hashes are computed over the record as written (a core without seq); the record is schema_invalid and, in a journal, takes no part in the chain checks.

vectors.name: seq-leading-zero
vectors.description: seq "07" has a leading zero; the canonical form is "7". schema_invalid.

vectors.name: seq-out-of-range
vectors.description: seq "18446744073709551616" is 2^64, one more than the largest allowed value. schema_invalid.

vectors.name: profile-valid
vectors.description: Record with profile example.measurement/1 and a payload that satisfies the profile schema. profile is part of the core.

vectors.name: profile-payload-invalid
vectors.description: Known profile, payload violates it: unit is missing and value is a number. The hashes are correct; profile_invalid makes the record invalid.

vectors.name: profile-major-unknown
vectors.description: Profile name known, major version 2 not in the registry. The core checks pass, so the record is valid; its profile state is outside_scope with the notice profile_unknown.

vectors.name: profile-name-unknown
vectors.description: Profile name not in the registry. Valid record, profile state outside_scope, notice profile_unknown.

vectors.name: profile-malformed
vectors.description: profile does not match <name>/<major> (upper-case letters). schema_invalid; profile state invalid.
